subject.title: fix(build): add explicit ESM format to nodeBuildConfig for type module package

question: Should maintainers take this explicit ESM build-format pin as cleanup, and if so should the merge metadata be rewritten so it does not close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91539?
rationale: The code change is small and coherent, but dependency inspection shows it is not a behavioral fix today; automation cannot decide whether maintainers want this defensive no-op pin or whether to preserve the linked issue until runtime package proof exists.

options.title: Merge As Cleanup With Safe Metadata
options.body: Accept the explicit ESM pin only with squash or merge metadata that treats it as cleanup and keeps the canonical regression open.

options.title: Close The Cleanup PR
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers do not want a no-op build-contract pin now that the inspect diagnostic fix has merged separately.

options.title: Accept The Closure Risk
options.body: Merge as-is only if maintainers intentionally consider this sufficient to close the canonical document-extract regression.

recommendation.title: Merge As Cleanup With Safe Metadata
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit ESM pin only with squash or merge metadata that treats it as cleanup and keeps the canonical regression open.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows this person touched both the build config and plugin inspect surfaces relevant to the cleanup and merge-risk decision.
